card.name: The word within before minutes
card.fires_on: The word "within" right before a short time span, usually minutes, after a dose, infusion or injection. It appears where onset or timing of a reaction or vomiting is described.

modes.label: Reaction onset
modes.description: "within" introduces how soon after administration a reaction began.
modes.example: In most cases, initial symptoms occurred<< within>> minutes of GBCA administration and resolved

modes.label: Vomiting after dose
modes.description: "within" introduces a time window after taking a dose in which vomiting or spitting up happens.
modes.example: If the patient vomits or spits up the dose<< within>> 30 minutes after receiving the dose

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "minutes" (and the same word in other languages) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on "within" when the text is about to say how many minutes after a dose something happened.
